title: MT5 sign-in troubleshooting
policy: Confirm that the user selected the correct trading server and used the trading account number (not the client portal email). A trading password is required but must never be requested by support. Check connectivity and suggest the official password-reset workflow if necessary. Never confirm a credential or reset a password yourself.
reply: Please check that you are using your trading account number, the correct trading server and a stable internet connection. If you still cannot sign in, use the secure password-reset option in the client portal. Please do not share your trading password with support.

title: Missing or pending deposit
policy: A missing or pending deposit must be routed to Finance for investigation. For a verified user and matching reference, the read-only transaction lookup may report a simulated status. Otherwise request the transaction reference via the secure client portal. Do not promise a credit, refund or completion time.
reply: I’m sorry your deposit has not appeared yet. Please provide the transaction reference through the secure client portal so our Finance team can investigate. We cannot confirm crediting or processing time until the transaction is reviewed.

title: Withdrawal status and investigation
policy: Withdrawal status requires verification and Finance review. A matching reference may be checked using the read-only status tool. Never guarantee an arrival time, reverse a transaction or approve a withdrawal.
reply: I understand that waiting for a withdrawal can be frustrating. Please share the transaction reference via the secure client portal so Finance can review the status. We cannot guarantee an arrival time until the review is complete.

title: Identity verification and KYC
policy: Users must upload requested identity or address documents through the secure client portal. Compliance alone can assess documents or communicate reasons for rejection after verification. Never ask for full identity documents, identification numbers, or copies by ordinary email.
reply: Please review the verification notification in your secure client portal and upload any requested documents there. If the reason for rejection is unclear, our Compliance team can review your case. Please do not send identity documents by ordinary email.

title: Demo and live account information
policy: The demo brokerage offers Demo and Live accounts. Demo accounts use virtual funds. Live accounts require completed onboarding and verification. Support explains account features but does not recommend a product or trading choice.
reply: A Demo account uses virtual funds for platform practice. A Live account requires completed onboarding and verification. You can review the available account options in the client portal; we can explain their features without recommending a trading decision.

title: Margin, leverage and stop-out terminology
policy: Support may explain general platform terminology. Leverage increases exposure relative to deposited funds; margin is collateral reserved to maintain positions; stop-out is a platform's automated closure mechanism at its applicable threshold. Current numerical conditions vary by account and must be checked in current approved specifications. No trading advice.
reply: Leverage changes the exposure you can control relative to your funds, while margin is collateral required for positions. Stop-out is an automated closure mechanism when the applicable margin threshold is reached. Please consult the current account specifications for exact conditions. We cannot recommend a trading strategy.

title: Bonus and promotion eligibility
policy: Promotion eligibility and dates are governed by current official campaign terms. No active bonus is asserted in the demo. Do not promise eligibility, credits or extensions. Route disputed eligibility to Promotions.
reply: Bonus eligibility depends on the current official campaign terms. Please check the promotion notice in the client portal. If you believe an eligibility decision is incorrect, our Promotions team can review it.

title: Platform connection and technical issues
policy: Check internet connectivity, platform update, device time and correct server. If the issue persists, request the platform version, device type and non-sensitive error text. Never request remote access or credentials.
reply: Please check your internet connection, confirm that the application is updated, and verify the server selection. If the problem continues, share your device type, platform version and non-sensitive error message so Technical Support can investigate.

title: Introducing broker and managed-account inquiries
policy: Partnership inquiries are routed to the Partnerships team. Managed-account information is descriptive only. Never recommend a manager, promise returns or approve a partnership.
reply: Our Partnerships team can explain the available introducing broker and managed-account arrangements. Please submit your inquiry in the secure client portal. We cannot promise returns, approve participation, or recommend a manager.

title: Security, compromised account and privacy
policy: Potential account compromise, unauthorized access and fraud must be escalated to Security. Never reveal another user's information or request passwords, OTPs, seed phrases or private keys. Advise users to use official secure account-recovery channels.
reply: For your security, please use the official secure account-recovery channel and do not share passwords, one-time codes, private keys or seed phrases here. Our Security team should review any suspected unauthorized activity.

title: Trading disputes and order execution
policy: Execution disputes require human review by Trading Operations. Support may request an order reference via the secure portal. Never guarantee an adjustment, admit liability or change a trade.
reply: I understand your concern about the order. Please provide the order reference and non-sensitive details through the secure client portal, so Trading Operations can investigate. We cannot confirm an adjustment before the review is completed.

title: Unknown requests and general support
policy: If there is no supported policy or insufficient detail, ask a concise clarifying question and route to General Support. Do not invent procedures, promises or account information.
reply: Thank you for contacting us. Could you provide a little more detail about the issue and the relevant service so our support team can assist? Please avoid sharing sensitive account information.
